rateLimits.note: This deployment's own dispatch budget per provider/model route, enforced before a request is sent so a route is never discovered to be over its limit by receiving a 429. The defaults are ours, not a claim about what any provider publishes; add a byProvider or byRoute entry when a limit is published or measured, with the source in its note.
